summary: While the US market is closed, sell 50% of the NVDA position for USDG if it falls at least 0.2% from the last US close.

checks.label: US market closed
checks.why: This check limits the rule to periods when the US market is closed.

checks.label: Drop from last close
checks.why: Trigger when NVDA is down at least 0.2% from the last US close.

checks.label: Limit price impact
checks.why: This Talos-added check limits the expected price impact to 1%.

checks.label: Prevent repeat sale
checks.why: This Talos-added check prevents another sale during the same closed stretch.

assumptions: “Sell half” is represented as a 50% sale.
The 1% price-impact limit is a Talos-added default.
